_what: The bring-up scoreboard: the compiled lane (codegen_cuda::lane, the model's one LOGOS program) against llama.cpp and the serving engines on the same GPU, one boot, every run kept. Written by scripts/accel/model_scoreboard.py; held by model_scoreboard_lock.

protocol.ours_decode: model_lane --bench int8 128 <100000,549,6077,280,7239,317> 16 1024: the decode rate over 128 generated tokens after a 6-token prompt, one warm-up then the timed runs
protocol.llama_cpp: llama-bench -p 512 -n 128 -r <repeats> -ngl 99: pp512 and tg128, every layer on the GPU
protocol.read_ceiling: scripts/accel/read_ceiling.cu: a 4 GiB buffer read once with 16-byte loads, the fastest launch shape, <repeats> runs; decode_bytes_per_token is model_lane --plan's Gguf::decode_read_bytes
protocol.numerics: the lane's one-word int8 activations, llama.cpp's own q8_1 precision
protocol.engines: scripts/accel/engine_bench_<engine>.py in the engine's own environment, batch 1, greedy, the end of text ignored, prefix caching off: a 512-token prompt generating 1 token, and a 6-token prompt generating 129 and 1, every run timed by the wall (prefill 512 / its time, decode 128 / the difference) and by the engine's own clock (prefill 512 / scheduled or prefill start to first token, decode 128 / first to last token); each engine's 8-bit weight form of the model, its checkpoint's weight files hashed
protocol.batch: model_lane --bench int8 129 <100000,549,6077,280,7239,317> 16 256 --batch=<B>: B sequences prefilled each into its own state, then decoded a token each a step together, sequence b's prompt the six tokens each moved 7919·b on modulo the vocabulary, the rate every sequence's 128 decoded tokens over the batch steps' time; vLLM at B concurrent requests of the same prompts (engine_bench_vllm.py --batch B): the wall's B·128 over (the B generating 129 − the B generating 1) and its own clock's over the last request's first to last token
protocol.quality: each side against benchmarks/models/<model>/golden-f32.json (llama.cpp's f32 run on the CPU), over its prompts as its tokens, each generated greedily for the golden's length: top1 the steps agreeing with the golden's continuation before the first that does not, of steps; top_logit_gap the mean over the prompts of |(the side's logit of the golden's top token - of its second) - (the golden's)| at the first generated position. Ours: model_lane's golden run, int8. llama.cpp: model-golden.sh device=cuda flash=auto kv=f16, as llama-bench runs it. Engines: engine_bench_<engine>.py --golden, their logprobs
